I am too old to be carrying heavy fertilizer bags from the market, and this small plot near my home has always given us enough cassava and yam without those costly chemicals. My children and grandchildren help me clear and weed the land, and we spread the goat manure from our compound to keep the soil strong. We plant the same vines and setts our family has used for generations, and we do not waste money on sprays or hiring workers for such a small garden.
